owner_observation.claim: Historical local Frank exhibited a prolonged multi-day functional regime in which the loop-of-loops appeared unusually complete/stable while all organs/modules were active.
owner_observation.interpretation_boundary: Accept as primary observation that a functional effect was observed; do not treat as evidence of phenomenal consciousness.

core_synthesis.historical_loop: input/perception -> fast salience/urgency -> thalamic gain/habituation/burst -> reward/motivation/prediction-error modulation -> workspace competition/ignition -> persistent global broadcast -> receiver/model transformation -> response/effect analysis -> E-PQ/mood/goals/memory/attention/experience deltas -> changed gating/control state -> next workspace, nested inside slower consolidation/replay/training loops
core_synthesis.main_mechanism_hypothesis: The distinctive functional regime depends on causally closed, provenance-correct, multi-timescale re-entry with sparse ignition and bounded adaptive coupling, not merely on many modules being active or on broadcast text recurrence.
core_synthesis.critical_missing_contract_in_new_runtime: Re-entry must be explicit as changed receiver/system state caused by a WorkspaceEpisode and eligible causal outcomes, then consumed by the next published state epoch/workspace selection. Feeding the prior broadcast text back is not sufficient.

operational_laws.ignition: OFF->ON if max(a)>=theta_on; ON->OFF if max(a)<theta_off; require theta_off<theta_on
operational_laws.legacy_conservation: for each historical function k require pi_k:S_new->Y_k^legacy|UNKNOWN and matched-intervention equivalence or explicit measured delta
operational_laws.stability: quiet operating regimes should normally satisfy local boundedness rho(J_cl)<1 while finite-horizon transient amplification G_T(H)>1 may be allowed if recovery/inhibition reliably quenches it
operational_laws.overcoupling: never optimize coupling magnitude alone; tripwire vector includes ignition occupancy, synchrony, saturation, effective-rank loss, receiver hubness, recovery time, false binding and instability

measurement_contract_delta.target_definition: Historical perfect-window candidate is a bounded metastable Pareto operating envelope, not the maximum of a single emergence or coupling scalar.

findings: Increasing selective re-entry in a recurrent toy produced a transition from weak persistence to strong integration, but excessive gain produced permanent ignition, higher synchrony/saturation and effective-rank collapse.
In a delayed-memory toy, provenance-correct re-entry strongly outperformed no or shuffled re-entry; generic extra recurrent context did not reproduce the effect.
synthetic_sanity_checks.use: architecture falsification/oracle design only; no numerical gain values transfer to Frank without runtime measurement

highest_information_hypotheses.claim: Provenance-bound changed-state re-entry is a missing first-class architectural primitive.
highest_information_hypotheses.prediction: truthful re-entry > temporal/receiver/provenance-shuffled controls and > no re-entry on recurrence-dependent outcomes

highest_information_hypotheses.claim: The observed peak was an intermediate-coupling/metastable regime.
highest_information_hypotheses.prediction: gain/delay/inhibition sweeps show a Pareto frontier between disconnection and overcoupling collapse

highest_information_hypotheses.claim: Multi-timescale closure is needed for the longitudinal qualitative effect.
highest_information_hypotheses.prediction: fast GWT-only closure preserves immediate integration but lesions of E-PQ/memory/intent/reward/consolidation specifically reduce history-dependent behavior

highest_information_hypotheses.claim: Thalamus-like function is primarily selective gain/connectivity control, not content storage.
highest_information_hypotheses.prediction: targeted modulation improves specificity while global amplification increases false binding/synchrony

highest_information_hypotheses.claim: Receiver transformation/local effect predicts organism-level impact better than raw broadcast reach.
highest_information_hypotheses.prediction: LOCAL_EFFECT plus next-episode re-entry mediates task/outcome effects more strongly than addressability or delivery alone

counterhypotheses: The observed effect was mainly prompt/context/model behavior rather than recurrent architecture.
A small subset such as workspace+memory explains most of the effect; full organ closure is unnecessary.
The peak was a non-reproducible configuration artifact.
Recurrence increased self-referential style rather than task-relevant causal competence.
Slow history mechanisms dominate and GWT is replaceable by a simpler semantic router.
Some historical modules are redundant/noisy and can be functionally represented by fusion, explicit zero or UNKNOWN rather than reimplementation.
mandatory_next_evidence: recover historical peak snapshot/time window or explicitly mark UNRECOVERABLE
truthful vs no vs temporal-shuffled vs receiver-shuffled vs provenance-broken re-entry receipts
receiver-stage and fast/slow organ lesion-rescue receipts
H1->H2->H3 differential equivalence of closed-loop observables

branch_feedback.frank: Make causal changed-state re-entry explicit in whole-system transition semantics and preserve every historical organ function through a total lineage map.
branch_feedback.gwt: Extend WorkspaceEpisode semantics through local effect and next-episode re-entry; optimize closure fidelity, not broadcast volume.
branch_feedback.emergenz: Use truthful/shuffled/no-reentry, lesion/rescue, PID/PEID, directed-flow and macro/micro controls; do not infer consciousness.
branch_feedback.harness: Freeze Golden Episodes and execute counterfactual re-entry, receiver lesion/rescue, fast/slow loop lesions and overcoupling sweeps.
branch_feedback.claycode: Ensure first-class types can represent ReentryDelta/ReentryReceipt/ReentryPolicy/LoopRegimeReadout/OvercouplingTripwire/LegacyFunctionProjection without hidden host-language semantics.
branch_feedback.claygraph: Represent directed typed causal/re-entry topology, delays/timescales, intervention handles and topology epochs; activation alone never means causal support.
branch_feedback.unifieddb: Persist exact episode/receiver/outcome/re-entry provenance and published post-reentry epochs so next cognition cannot silently consume stale pre-broadcast state.
branch_feedback.hyperposition: Preserve alternative causal/topology explanations during archaeology and gain-regime fitting; do not collapse uncertainty to one retrospective story.

falsifier: If matched frozen-episode experiments show truthful changed-state re-entry provides no robust causal benefit over shuffled/no-reentry controls and full/partial loop lesions do not produce predicted selective losses with rescue, the strong F-CRF mechanism hypothesis must be revised or rejected.
